normalization.nodeid: pytest nodeid exactly as the counts plugin recorded it, with every backslash replaced by '/', a leading './' removed, and nothing else changed: the file path keeps its repository-relative form (no drive letter, no absolute prefix), the '::' separators stay, and a parametrised id keeps its '[param]' suffix verbatim
normalization.nodeid_set_sha256: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of every normalised selected nodeid joined by a newline with one trailing newline; duplicates are not collapsed, because the counts validator already refuses a selected list with duplicates
normalization.order: interpreter string sort (sorted()), which is code-point order and locale-free
normalization.per_test_sha256: sha256 of one JSON array per test, [nodeid, outcome, reason], serialised with separators (',', ':') and ensure_ascii=False, ordered by normalised nodeid, joined by newlines with one trailing newline; reason is the phase's wasxfail when present, else the phase's skip reason, else an empty string
